   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 2, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Plockq_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This app went from one of the better ai apps to being completely unusable No more search function Even more ads Daily chat limit even with ads"
            2. _Zero free chats?!!_, Jul 2, 2026, 1/5: "The app is unusable. I have a free account but it always says 0 free messages. Can’t chat to any bots. I emailed customer service multiple times and they won’t fix it or help me. I used to enjoy the app before they took away free chats."
            3. _mellisa2005_xx_, Aug 2, 2026, 2/5: "At first it was a very good app for building your own story’s and yeah the messages were kind of annoying if you were really into a good story and then you run out of messages i mean hello we already have a lot of adds which i don’t really mind because they gotta pay this somehow. my biggest problem is definitely that at one point it didnt work at all. i had 0 messages left and i thought „hm okay i’ll just wait, not a big deal“ so i’m offline for three days and as i come back and type it say i have 0 messages left uhmm helloo? it’s still broken i hope it gets fixed in the next 6 weeks!! enjoy the summer holidays guys and fix the app please gng."
